Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist

Class LifetimeStats

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.persist.LifetimeStats
public class LifetimeStats extends Object
Totals across every finished run (tutorials excluded), kept in a simple key=value text file by SaveStore.
